description: This file defines an interface for admin controllers within the Goteo application, specifying required methods for implementations that manage administrative functionalities.

classes.name: AdminControllerInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying required static methods for admin controllers in the Goteo application.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the controller.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns routing information (Route or RouteCollection) for the admin submodule.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the HTML label or title for the admin module.

methods.name: getSidebar
methods.description: Provides an array for the sidebar menu; if none, an auto-generated link is created.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given User has permission to adminster the controller for a specific URI.
